title: Well Shin WS-157 13A 250V UK 3-Pin to NEMA 5-15R Electrical Plug Adapter

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Well Shin WS-157 13A 250V Adapter Plug is a high-quality electrical adapter designed for users who need to connect American-style NEMA 5-15 plugs to UK-type BS1363 outlets. This durable adapter supports up to 13 Amps at 250 Volts, ensuring safe and reliable power transmission for devices like chargers, tools, and electronic appliances.


Built with heat-resistant materials and precision contacts, the WS-157 ensures a secure connection every time. It is ideal for both personal and professional use in offices, workshops, and travel applications.

Key Features:


  • Model: Well Shin WS-157
  • Converts: UK 3-Pin Plug → NEMA 5-15R Socket
  • Input Voltage: 250V
  • Current Rating: 13A
  • Color: Black
  • Durable and heat-resistant plastic housing
  • Compact design, easy to carry and use
  • Suitable for travel, office, and home use
  • Does not convert voltage (plug type only)

Note: Ensure your device supports 220–250V before use.
